note: Primitive Cherokee NF campground along Tumbling Creek near Ocoee No. 3 Lake, in the Big Frog Mountain area, reached on gravel FR 45 and FR 221. No designated pads or picnic tables; reports say only the first couple of sites fit a medium RV or trailer with room to turn. --Claude
summary: Tumbling Creek (Cherokee NF): FS page + rec.gov search + Esri/3DEP. Open, free, FCFS (no rec.gov listing), 8 sites, no restrooms/water/tables, max 5 people + 2 vehicles. No access/vehicle wording from the FS. Creekside KEPT (clearings ~2 m above the creek, 25-35 m away down a gentle wooded slope, nothing between).
flags: WATERFRONT creekside KEPT: FS '8 campsites along the banks of Tumbling Creek'; imagery shows the camp clearings between the access track and the creek, 25-35 m from the canopy-covered channel (e.g. 35.01728,-84.46629 -> creek 35.01710,-84.46596); 3DEP 445.2-446.0 m at the clearings vs 443.4 m creek bed = an easy ~2 m walk down with nothing between. Sites are unnumbered (dispersed-style, no pads), so no site numbers exist to cite.
REC.GOV: no listing found (by name or within 10 mi) -> reservable false, fcfs always confirmed.

ACCESS: the FS page has no 4WD/high-clearance or trailer wording; the RV-fit claim in the note ('first couple of sites fit medium RVs/trailers ... 23-ft feasible') is NOT on the FS page - its source is a camper report from the original sweep (unread this pass). Kept, worded as 'reports say'. The old note's 'easiest approach is paved Grassy Creek Rd ... ~2 mi on FR 221' is not FS wording and was dropped; the FS route is FR 45 2.9 mi + FR 221 6.9 mi.
SEASON: the FS page gives no operational hours; year_round stays derived (unconfirmed).
ELEVATION: stored 468 m vs USGS 3DEP 445-446 m at the clearings - reviewer may correct elevation_meters.
